chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Nuʿmān said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
I come out from the place of relieving myself and perform istinjāʾ with water, then my garment falls into that water with which I performed istinjāʾ.
So he said: “There is no harm in it, and there is nothing upon you.”

key_terms.الْمَاءِ: water used in the act mentioned
key_terms.فَأَسْتَنْجِي: I cleanse myself after relieving myself using water
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ شَيْءٌ: no liability or consequence is upon you

ai.seo_question: Does clothing become impure if it falls into water used for istinjāʾ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning water used for istinjāʾ and its contact with clothing. Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that if one's garment falls into such water, there is no harm and no consequence upon the person.
